cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Understand the Hurt
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge why their action hurt, not merely agree that it happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you apologise for missing my concert, tell me what you think you're apologising for. We need to get this right.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said I'd come, and work ran late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the sequence of events. Please try the part where I looked at your empty seat before every song. You'd heard me practise for months.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You wanted someone there who knew how hard you'd worked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Keep that in the apology. Not 'sorry I was late'; you weren't there to hear what all that practice became.

reason: Make A's patient, strained corrections distinguish chronology from the personal meaning of absence, using B's partial understanding rather than denying it.
